lines.en: I pace slowly, as if on patrol.

lines.zh: 这身甲壳压得地面发闷
lines.en: My shell makes the ground sound dull.

lines.zh: 四足落地，每一步都不轻
lines.en: Four feet land; not one is light.
I walk the edge of the village.
My tendrils probe ahead of me.
Where I pass, the grass lies flat.
I head toward whatever lives.
Before a hunt I don't hurry. Slow.

lines.zh: 我身后拖着湿漉漉的痕
lines.en: A wet trail follows behind me.
This ground is my hunting range.
I lie low without a tremor.

lines.zh: 甲壳上的纹路一直在动
lines.en: The patterns on my shell keep shifting.

lines.zh: 我在听，很远的脚步也听
lines.en: I listen. Even distant steps register.

lines.zh: 这具身体比从前大太多了
lines.en: This body is far larger than before.
I press my head very low.
My breath comes out cold and damp.
The quiet around me feels wrong.
I slowly open the plates on my back.
Something crawls on me. I ignore it.
I crouch and let the prey move first.

lines.zh: 身体在慢慢地长，停不下来
lines.en: My body keeps growing; it won't stop.

lines.zh: 海水的声音在我体内响
lines.en: The sound of the sea echoes inside me.
I lift a forelimb, then set it down.

lines.zh: 这片陆地让我很不舒服
lines.en: This dry land sits badly with me.
I spit out a little seawater.
I'm counting the living things nearby.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，我嗅到汗了。
lines.en: You're too close — I smell your sweat.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，比你高出许多
lines.en: I raise my head, well above yours.
You're trembling. I can smell it.
You're not like those villagers.
You won't get through this shell.

lines.zh: 这么大一只猫，眨眼要很久。
lines.en: A cat this size takes a long time to blink.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我脚下很小
lines.en: Your shadow is small at my feet.

lines.zh: 我偏头，看你手上有什么
lines.en: I tilt my head to see what's in your hands.
I'm in no hurry. Neither should you be.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我，脖子都要仰断了。
lines.en: You look up at me; your neck must ache.
I'll remember your scent.

lines.zh: 在这片地上，你跑不过我
lines.en: On this ground, you can't outrun me.
I step back; my shell creaks.
This little wound is nothing.
I guard the seam in my plates.
Fluid seeps out, cold.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，震得地面响
lines.en: I roar, and the ground rattles.

lines.zh: 你打中了甲壳薄的地方
lines.en: You hit a thin part of my shell.
I lower my body and draw back.
It hurts, but I won't leave.
My bulk caves in the ground.
This body is mending itself.
That morsel won't even fill a tooth.
Food? I'd rather have it living.

lines.zh: 这么点肉，填不满我的牙缝。
lines.en: That scrap won't fill the gap between my teeth.
I lean in, sniff, and withdraw.

lines.zh: 这东西不是海里的味道
lines.en: This doesn't smell of the sea.
I don't need feeding by you.
Three-and-a-half-block paws land first.
I'm hungry — just not for that.
Raise it higher so I can see.
Keep it. I have a use for it later.

lines.zh: 你撞在我壳上，弹回去了
lines.en: You hit my shell and bounced off.
I didn't even turn my head.
With my bulk, even a corridor is narrow.
Being this close to me is dangerous.
I turn aside and make a little room.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我的甲一点没动
lines.en: A bump; my plates didn't shift.
Get clear. I don't want to crush you.
My tendrils brush your face.

lines.zh: 地面的土被我们挤开了
lines.en: The soil's pushed aside between us.
Consider yourself lucky this time.

lines.zh: 海嗣不懂这些，只懂吞食。
lines.en: The sea-born know only feeding.
We only ever grow in number.
Our kind gathers only to feed.

lines.zh: 你身上，闻不到海嗣的咸味。
lines.en: You don't smell of the sea-born.
I don't seek partners. I seek prey.

lines.zh: 离我远些，我不喜欢贴着
lines.en: Stay back. I dislike closeness.

lines.zh: 这片陆地迟早是我们的
lines.en: This land will be ours in time.
I will keep growing.
Don't imitate what we are.
If you go, I won't remember.
One bite and it's crushed.
Ground scraps aren't worth bending for.

lines.zh: 我用爪子把它拨进浅水。
lines.en: I bat it into the shallows.
Too small to bother with.
I press it into the tidal mud.
I scoop up a heap and swallow it.
It's gritty. Not good.
This isn't food.
I leave it where it lies.
My claws aren't made for holding.
Something living moves.
I raise my head and lock on.
There's a villager over there.
The iron golem's steps are heavy.
I move first; then it will know.
That scent is new to me.
The muscle under my shell tightens.
It won't get far.
I lower my body, ready to spring.
One prey is enough.
This ground is mine now.

lines.zh: 我不吼，只是把身子压低。
lines.en: I don't roar — I just lower my bulk.
It turned. Good.
I move — slow, but without stopping.
Every tendril points that way.
I want to hear what sound it makes.
From now on, it's mine.
It begins.
Each step shakes the ground as I close in.
It goes left; I block left.
My shadow falls over it first.
It retreats; I don't speed up.
I can hear its heartbeat.
Two steps more and I can reach it.
It means to get behind the house.
I don't go around. I go through walls.
My weight alone will do it.
It's calling for help.
I don't care how many come.
My tendrils have cut off its retreat.
The ground cracks under my feet.
Soon. Very soon.
I smell its fear.
It's against the wall now.
This whole area will go quiet.
I spread my forelimbs.
Now.
I bring my weight down.
I bring a claw down.
My tendrils coil around its legs.
I crush down with my full weight.
The impact throws it clear.
My shell's edge scores the ground.
Once bitten, I don't let go.
Its bones crack in my jaws.
This strike is only for feeding.
I shake my head, hard.
Blood soaks into the soil, quickly.
It's still moving. I strike again.
My breathing grows heavier.
I don't chase. It won't escape.
This prey was worth it.
I crawl up out of the sea.
Water pours off my shell.

lines.zh: 这具身体太大了，我试着动
lines.en: This body is huge; I try to move.
The dry air on land stings.

lines.zh: 我抬起身体，第一次看见村子
lines.en: I rear up and see the village for the first time.

lines.zh: 这片陆地比我记得的更大
lines.en: This land is bigger than I remember.

lines.zh: 我的触须在空气里摸索
lines.en: My tendrils test the air.
The sea recedes behind me.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，很远都听见
lines.en: I roar, and it carries far.
This will be my hunting ground.
I rise slowly to my full height.
Sand and gravel slide off me.

lines.zh: 我记得海里的味道，这里没有
lines.en: I remember the sea's taste. This has none.
I head toward the light.

lines.zh: 海边的介壳类都缩了回去
lines.en: The shellfish along the shore all withdraw.
I have finally set foot on land.
This body is still growing.

lines.zh: 我要看看这里有什么能吃
lines.en: Let me see what's edible here.

lines.zh: 一声低吼从我的壳里传出
lines.en: A low growl sounds from within my shell.
I begin to survey this new ground.
The fire cracks my shell.

lines.zh: 我从高处坠下，壳都陷了
lines.en: I fall from a height and my shell dents.
The water is too deep. That shouldn't be.
The blast wave rolls me over.
Something sharp lodges in my shell's seam.

lines.zh: 这股力量在灼烧我的血
lines.en: This power burns my blood.
Too long without feeding; I've shrunk.

lines.zh: 雷打中甲壳，我浑身一僵
lines.en: Lightning hits my shell; I lock up.
I fall into the void, and my shell peels away.
